definitions.explanation: A written account of a journey, describing places visited, experiences had, and impressions formed during travel.

examples.japanese: {旅行記|りょこうき}を{書|か}く。
{彼女|かのじょ}のヨーロッパ{旅行記|りょこうき}がブログで{人気|にんき}だ。
examples.english: Her European travelogue is popular on her blog.

examples.japanese: {明治|めいじ}{時代|じだい}の{作家|さっか}による{旅行記|りょこうき}を{読|よ}むと、{当時|とうじ}の{日本|にほん}の{様子|ようす}がよく{分|わ}かる。
examples.english: Reading travelogues by Meiji-era writers gives a good picture of what Japan was like at the time.

notes:
A compound of {旅行|りょこう} (travel) and {記|き} (record/account). Can refer to anything from a casual blog post about a trip to a published literary work.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {旅行記|りょこうき}を{書|か}く: to write a travelogue
- {旅行記|りょこうき}を{読|よ}む: to read a travelogue
- {海外|かいがい}{旅行記|りょこうき}: overseas travel journal

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {紀行文|きこうぶん}: travel essay — more literary; implies a polished piece of writing rather than a personal record
- {旅日記|たびにっき}: travel diary — more personal and day-by-day in format
- {旅行|りょこう}ブログ: travel blog — the modern, casual equivalent
